saints.name: Genevieve
saints.legacy: Patroness of Paris and protector of the faithful.
saints.summary: Saint Genevieve was a 5th-century virgin and the patroness of Paris. Known for her piety and miraculous interventions, she played a crucial role in protecting the city during sieges, particularly against Attila the Hun. Her legacy endures as a symbol of faith and resilience in the face of adversity.
